sections.h2: What we write for a robotics company, and what we have shipped
paras: Medical robotics software, as Elevate Aura offers it, means the software layers around a machine your team has designed: firmware on the controllers, the communication between them over CAN, Modbus or serial, an operator or companion app, and a cloud layer so a support team can see a machine sitting on a customer site.

Being precise about the track record matters here. Elevate Aura has worked with a medical robotics company, Medline Robotics in Chennai, and what we built for them was an e-commerce and distributor platform, not its robot software. This page offers device software capability rather than a robotics reference.

The engagement is software-only. Mechanical design, the arm or stage, electronics, PCB design, manufacturing and hardware regulatory certification stay with your team, along with the safety architecture and the regulatory route. We write software to your specification and deliver documentation your team can use in its own submissions.

sections.h2: The mechanics are impressive. The software is several prototypes.

sections.h2: Getting robotics software written, three ways.
rows: Yours, and we say so plainly

items.q: Have you written software for a medical robot?
items.a: Not the robot software. Elevate Aura built an e-commerce and distributor platform for Medline Robotics, a medical robotics company in Chennai: storefront, distributor portal, quotations, ordering, payment verification and SEO landing pages. The device software capability described here is offered on its own merits. See the Medline Robotics case study.

items.q: Do you design the robot or its electronics?
items.a: No. This is a software-only engagement. Mechanical design, the arm or stage, electronics, PCB design, component sourcing, manufacturing and hardware regulatory certification all stay with your team. We write firmware, communication and application software to your specification.

Your team does. Safety design, hazard analysis and the regulatory route are yours, and we implement to the behaviour your specification defines. We deliver design, interface and test documentation your team can use in its own submissions, and we do not claim compliance on your behalf.

items.q: Can you handle the bus between our controllers?
items.a: Yes. CAN is the usual choice inside a machine with several controllers, with Modbus or serial where those are already in use. See CAN bus software development for how the message and identifier plan is handled.

items.q: Can we see machines on customer sites?
items.a: Yes. Usage, faults and firmware versions are reported into a pipeline on Supabase or Azure and shown on a dashboard with alerts and roles. See device dashboard development.
